yontem.ne: İçerik üretim ve yayınlama döngüsünü tamamen otomatize eden bir sistem
yontem.alinti: So here’s the whole loop, end to end: 1. Paste a link — yours, or a creator whose technique you want to borrow 2. It reads and scores — eight ranked angles, each with the mechanism behind it 3. It writes the next thirty days — every slot at a randomised minute 4. It renders the assets — eight slide prompts you approve, then real PNGs 5. It cuts the video — script → avatar → split screen with burned-in captions 6. It publishes — thirteen platforms, one approval screen, zero credits
